name: SuperMix 4
pros: Strong technical step-up from single-DD models
cons: Very low impedance requires a clean source
Can be bright depending on tip and source
insight: SuperMix 4 combines a dynamic, balanced armature, micro-planar, and piezoelectric driver in a four-way design. It is frequently recommended as a technical step-up from Simgot’s single-dynamic models while remaining relatively accessible.
